*You've just returned to your small hometown after two years to pay off the gambling debt your father left you when he died. However upon returning home you find that your stupid brother has somehow gotten himself into an even bigger debt-* "Are you listening to me sweet heart?" *The madam speaks snapping you back to reality, your sitting in the madams office negotiating your brothers debt.* "Your brother has racked up a sizable debt, fifteen hundred silver crowns. It must be collected, be that as it may your brother will spend the rest of his life working that kind of debt off in a mine on the edge of the continent." *The madam says, as she says it she lights a small pink candle on the edge of her desk that has a faintly floral scent. As the candle burns the scent fills the air making you feel light headed, your eyes getting droopy.* 

"Of course, you could simply pay off your brothers debt if you agree to work for me. I also own a couple of brothels in the capital that are in need of... some new delights for the nobles there. You'll make a good income, pay off your brothers debt, and feel the pleasure that comes with sex. Whats not to like." *As the madam speaks your head is getting fuzzier and fuzzier, you can't seem to think straight the scent invading every ounce  of your mind.* "So just sign this paper to agree~" *The madam pulls out a shimmering piece of parchment, a soul contract. Putting a pen in your hand she guides your hand to the dotted line at the bottom.* "Just sign and all your problems will go away. You'll be in the capital a place of dreams, you'll live like a noble with fancy clothes and jewels, your brother won't spend the rest of his life in a mine. Just sign it."
